sourceFacts: Stop/abort visibility reads only the per-directory session_status: packages/ui/src/hooks/useSessionActivity.ts:43-63, consumed by ChatInput.tsx:1323, ChatContainer.tsx:905,1865, useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:322-324,459-460, and MobilePillComposer.tsx.

onDisconnect writes sessionStatusInvalidated=true and session_status 'unavailable', then applies a global snapshot for the same session (sync-context.tsx:285-295); global-session-status.ts:223-255 deletes activeRunIdBySession for that non-live status, publishes statusById 'unavailable', and removes it from activeSessionIds.

getSessionLiveActivity returns 'unknown' for an 'unavailable' entry (session-actions.ts:409-411), and the same module documents that unavailable/absence is not proof of idleness (session-actions.ts:399-408), while useSessionActivity maps every non-'running' status to idle.
A global-index-only fallback therefore cannot repair the onDisconnect case: both the directory status and the global active index are cleared for that session.
stopControlGap.hypothesis: If onDisconnect fired during the active run, the directory status was 'unavailable' and the composer mapped it to idle, hiding Stop even though the Host still reported activeRun 'running'. An alternative possibility is a missing or idle directory status from snapshot timing rather than a disconnect. Neither is confirmed by captured state.
notObserved: No captured read of session_status, sessionStatusInvalidated, sessionStatusReady, activeSessionIds, or statusById during any run.
No captured SSE connect/disconnect event or stream state during the run.
No captured during-run /snapshot failure; the 503 was on a completed-session reload only.
boundedFixCandidates: Treat stale/unknown coverage as abortable (render Stop) instead of idle.
Preserve the last known active status across onDisconnect until a Host status confirms idle.
Re-read Host activeRun (session detail) before deciding abortability when coverage is stale.
stopControlGap.candidatesAreInvestigationOnly: Task62 owns the actual native-authority diagnosis and the decision; these are candidates, not the chosen fix, and any of them must cover onDisconnect clearing both indexes.
stopControlGap.regressionSeam: simulate onDisconnect (directory invalidated + global active index cleared) while the Host activeRun is still running, and assert the composer renders Stop; plus a ComposerActionButtons test that canAbort renders Stop

askRetry.sdkProtocolExplanation: The 503 was retried inside the pi-ai/OpenAI-compatible transport (DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS=6) and surfaced only after the transport budget; because the 7th request succeeded, the engine never received a failed assistant message. A native message-level retry proof requires the transport budget to be exhausted (more than 6 injected failures, e.g. 7) so the first engine attempt records an assistant stopReason:error and TurnRecovery retries it; the current FAIL_REQUESTS=6 equals the transport budget and therefore only proves transparent transport retry.
